- Data structure: an implementation in a language

explanations.question: What does an abstract data type describe?

options.A: The data and the operations allowed on it
options.B: How the data is laid out in memory
options.C: The Java code of each operation
options.D: The order in which items are stored

misconception.label: ADT as storage
misconception.description: Believes an ADT says how the data is kept in memory.

options.A: The data and the operations allowed on it

misconception.label: ADT tied to a language

explanations.question: Which collection does not allow duplicate items?

misconception.label: Bag rejects duplicates
misconception.description: Believes a bag keeps only one copy of each item.

explanations.question: Which item does a stack remove first?

misconception.label: Stack works like a queue
misconception.description: Believes a stack removes the oldest item first, as a queue does.

explanations.question: Which is one of the three main ideas of object-oriented programming covered here?

misconception.label: Recursion as an OOP idea
misconception.description: Believes recursion is one of the main ideas of object-oriented programming.

explanations.question: Why are an object's fields usually declared private?

options.A: To keep the data from being changed directly from outside
options.B: To make the program run faster
options.C: To let any class change the data

misconception.label: Private for speed
misconception.description: Believes private fields exist to make programs faster.
